notes.title: Lost Magic Is Here - Full Release Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
It’s happened! Lost Magic is now on Steam and out of Early Access! ✨

🔮 Immerse yourself in a world that has lost its magic - a land full of ancient secrets and mysteries. Exciting adventures, unique spells, and dangerous enemies await you. Explore, fight, and uncover secrets that no one has yet conquered. Be the one to restore lost magic to this world. The world needs its heroes - start your adventure now!

Since Early Access, we’ve worked together to fix bugs, add new features, and prepare the game for release. Thanks to you - Lost Magic is now officially launched!

[b]What’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Dungeon System: [/b]The Crypt can now be completed solo, with the option to choose power-ups after each boss. A group mode with higher difficulty and better rewards will be added later. Both modes will gradually expand to other dungeons too.
[*] [b]New Crypt Boss:[/b] Following your feedback, a new boss has appeared in the Crypt, and Silence will return later as an optional fight.
[*] [b]New Skills and Talents:[/b] The starting skills and the first two talent tiers for each Path have been completely reworked.
[*] [b]Updated Start:[/b] Improved tutorial, starting quests, and rewards.
[*] [b]Mod Updates:[/b] A free daily quest and increased drop rates for valuable mods. Mods now bind items to your character, and a mod trading system is coming soon.
[*] [b]Library and Bestiary: [/b]All discovered notes are now stored in the library, and the bestiary reveals detailed info about enemies.
[*] Plus many other improvements, fixes, and balance tweaks.
[/list]Thank you for joining us during beta and staying with us! Your support makes Lost Magic better - and we’ll keep growing together!

notes.title: Release of Lost Magic!
notes.notes:
🎉 Dear players!
Since the launch of Early Access, we’ve been closely monitoring the game, fixing bugs 🐛, and analyzing your feedback 🗣️. Thanks to this collaboration with the community, we’ve not only addressed many issues and introduced new mechanics ⚙️, but also outlined a clear path for the game’s future development 🗺️.

And now, we're excited to announce that the full release is coming on July 17! 🥳

🔑 Key changes:
[list]
[*] New dungeon system. The Crypt can now be completed alone, choosing buffs after each boss. Group mode will appear later with increased difficulty and rewards 🎁. Both modes will be gradually introduced for other dungeons 🏰.
[*] New boss in the Crypt. Following the wishes of the players, a new boss has appeared in the Crypt, and Silence will return later and will be optional 📣.
[*] New abilities and talents. A complete rework of the starting abilities and the first two tiers of talents for each Path 🌟.
[*] Updated start. The tutorial, starting tasks and rewards  have been reworked 🚀.
[*] Mod update. Free daily quest and increased chance of valuable mods dropping. Mods now make items personal, and mod exchange will be added soon 🎯.
[*] Library and bestiary. All found notes are now stored in the library, and the bestiary will reveal details about enemies 🐉.
[*] And many other improvements, fixes and balance adjustments ⚖️.
[/list]
Thank you for actively participating in beta testing and for staying with us. Your support makes the game better – and we continue to move forward with you! 🚀

notes.title: Big Changes Are Coming!
notes.notes:
🎮 Dear players!
After carefully studying your feedback and wishes, it was decided to rework some key mechanics of the game.
And now, after several months of hard work, we are finally ready to present a short list of changes 🛠️:
[list]
[*] New dungeon system
[*] New starting abilities and talents
[*] Mod update
[*] Updated tutorial and starting rewards
[*] Added library and bestiary
[*] Updated English translation
[*] ...and many other changes!
[/list]The game will be updated on June 22. From 19:00 to 21:00 UTC, there will be maintenance. The game will be unavailable for about 2 hour 🕒. 

📄A full list of changes will be published after the work is completed.

notes.title: Update: New Maps, Interface Improvements, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
It's time for fresh content and long-awaited improvements! The new build brings both visual updates and meaningful changes to the interface and gameplay behavior.

🔥 What's New:
[olist]
[*] Cloaks are now visible
[*] New Desert Map
[*] New Twilight City Map
[*] The map now opens in the tab that matches your current region (when possible)
[*] Simple tooltips when hovering over stats, objects, guilds, and more — fast and convenient
[/olist]
🧭 Interface Improvements:
[olist]
[*] We’ve reworked the tooltip behavior to make it more intuitive and consistent:
[*] Tooltips now appear on hover, not on click
[*] Clicking now hides the tooltip if it’s open
[*] Tooltips no longer conflict with each other (especially during loot distribution in groups)
[/olist]
✨ Minor but Pleasant Changes:
[olist]
[*] Added three rabbit pets
[*] Updated weapon icons and twilight area visuals
[*] Improved hairstyles
[*] New behavior when clicking on the character panel:
[/olist][list]
[*] Click on avatar — opens character window
[*] Click on name — opens party management menu
[/list]
🛠 Bug Fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed bugs related to image loading
[*] Fixed issue where boots appeared over pants
[*] Fixed issue where bracers appeared over sleeves
[*] Fixed hairstyles under helmets
[*] Fixed request handling issues
[*] Fixed problem with selling without confirmation
[*] Fixed message color display in the "Report Message" window
[*] Fixed server connection behavior — the "infinite authorization" issue should now occur less often (or be gone entirely)
[*] Fixed loot distribution window behavior when inventory was full
[*] And various other small fixes for subtle and tricky issues
[/olist]
See you in game!
Jump in on April 18 at 20:00 UTC — let's explore the new together!

notes.title: LostMagic Update: Improvements, Fixes & Exciting Changes!
notes.notes:
Experience the latest improvements and fixes!

✨ What's New?

- Improved enemy models in the desert and twilight areas.
- Updated the Morpheus set.

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

- Fixed a chat bug where changing locations prevented receiving messages from other channels.
- Chat now updates more frequently when you're in the arena or arcane.
- Fixed the display of the constructor in the shop.
- Improved the behavior of inventory windows.
- Items can now be properly split in the bank.
- Timers in the settings now show the number of days if the timer exceeds 24 hours.
- Fixed the behavior of real-money purchases on Steam.
- Updated localization strings.

Enjoy the update and stay tuned for more! 🔥

notes.title: 🔮 LostMagic Update: Improvements, Fixes & Exciting New Features!
notes.notes:
The update is here, bringing a big journal overhaul, global chat, and important fixes!

⚒️ What’s new?

Massive journal redesign:
- The main journal, quest page, pet page, and abilities page all got a fresh look.
- You can now unlock a sixth ability slot!
- Global chat is live! Stay connected with players everywhere.
- Friends & enemies lists in settings have been updated for better usability.
- Removed a misleading pop-up when purchasing in the store.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements:

- No more disappearing messages in chat!
- Fixed AFK loot window endlessly opening (mushrooms, transistors, books, etc.).
- Fixed marking in settings and localization issues.
- Fixed pump behavior in the desert.
- Fixed pump updates after capture.
- Fixed errors with incorrect behavior of the game when the battle is not finished.
- Fixed the title text when the transaction completion error occurs when buying bundles.

✨ What’s next?

We’re already working on the next update with even more improvements! Keep the feedback coming - it truly helps us make the game better!

💬 Tell us what you think! 🚀
